notice: Derived extraction; authentication, transport envelopes and payload staging omitted. Original hash is in the disposition manifest. Device output is an observation, not proof of emitted light.

observations.command:
set -eu
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
stat -c '%u %g %a %F' /tmp/researcher-usb-onset-5e113630055b4e81a0e0b94e5fd52ad6
find /tmp/researcher-usb-onset-5e113630055b4e81a0e0b94e5fd52ad6 -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -printf '%f %s\n'
sha256sum /tmp/researcher-usb-onset-5e113630055b4e81a0e0b94e5fd52ad6/*
cat /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/devnum
cat /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/power/runtime_status
if test -L /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:1.2/driver; then readlink /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:1.2/driver; else echo VENDOR_INTERFACE_UNBOUND; fi
if command -v fuser; then
n=$(cat /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/devnum)
node=$(printf '/dev/bus/usb/007/%03d' "$n")
if fuser "$node" 2>&1; then echo FUSER_PRESENT; else echo FUSER_NO_HOLDER_OR_ERROR; fi
else echo FUSER_UNAVAILABLE; fi
